turns.answer: I have been having persistent lower back pain and joint stiffness in the mornings.
turns.next_question: How long have you been experiencing this lower back pain and stiffness?

turns.answer: It started about two months ago after some heavy gardening work.
turns.next_question: On a scale from 1 to 10, how would you rate your back pain?

turns.answer: The pain is about a 6 out of 10, worse when sitting for long periods.
turns.next_question: Does the pain limit your ability to perform daily activities such as walking, bending, or lifting?

turns.answer: It feels like a dull, aching sensation with occasional sharpness when standing up.
turns.next_question: Do you have any tingling, numbness, weakness, or changes in bowel or bladder function?

turns.answer: I also notice some fatigue in the afternoons, but no fever or numbness.
मुझे पिछले एक महीने से पेट में गैस और भोजन के बाद भारीपन की समस्या है।
turns.next_question: Do your symptoms get worse after meals, on an empty stomach, or after specific foods?

turns.answer: यह समस्या करीब 4 हफ्ते पहले शुरू हुई थी जब मेरा खान-पान अनियमित हुआ।
turns.next_question: How would you rate the severity of your stomach discomfort on a scale of 1-10?

turns.answer: दर्द हल्का है, 10 में से लगभग 4, लेकिन असहजता बनी रहती है।
turns.next_question: Have you noticed any change in bowel habits, like constipation, looseness, or straining?

turns.answer: पेट में जलन और भारीपन जैसा महसूस होता है, भूख भी कम लगती है।
turns.next_question: What helps relieve the burning sensation in your stomach?

turns.answer: खट्टी डकारें आती हैं, लेकिन उल्टी या बुखार नहीं है।
મને છેલ્લા પંદર દિવસથી ગળામાં ખારાશ અને હળવી ઉધરસ રહે છે.
turns.next_question: How many days have you had this cough or congestion?

turns.answer: આ તકલીફ 15 દિવસ પહેલાં ઋતુ બદલાવા સાથે શરૂ થઈ હતી.
turns.next_question: Did this start suddenly or gradually?

turns.answer: તીવ્રતા 10 માંથી 3 જેટલી છે, સવારે વધારે તકલીફ થાય છે.
turns.next_question: Did anything specific seem to trigger or bring on this problem?

turns.answer: ગળામાં સૂકાપણું અને ખંજવાળ જેવો દુખાવો રહે છે.
turns.next_question: What seems to make it feel better, such as rest, warmth, or a specific position?

turns.answer: શરીરમાં થોડી સુસ્તી લાગે છે, પરંતુ કોઈ તાવ કે શ્વાસ લેવામાં તકલીફ નથી.
